question.content: 你能幫我計劃一趟旅行嗎？我想先在加州舊金山找一家營業至少到晚上10點的純素餐廳。然後，我想預訂同一城市的一家酒店。我偏好從7月1日開始住3晚的豪華客房，並希望酒店可以接受寵物並有健身房。之後，我想找到金州勇士隊在接下來5場NBA比賽的賽程表。最後，我有一副撲克牌，想在裡面找到紅心的皇后。

function_schema.name: hotel_booking
function_schema.description: Books a hotel room given the location, room type, stay duration and any additional preferences.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

room_type.description: Type of the room required. Options: 'single', 'double', 'deluxe', etc.

duration.description: The number of nights you want to book the hotel for.

start_date.description: The date when your stay begins.

preferences.description: Optional preferences of stay at the hotel. Default is none if not provided.

function_schema.name: sports_team.get_schedule
function_schema.description: Fetches the schedule of the specified sports team for the specified number of games in the given league.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

num_of_games.description: Number of games for which to fetch the schedule.

league.description: The name of the sports league. If not provided, the function will fetch the schedule for all games, regardless of the league.

location.description: Optional. The city or venue where games are to be held. If not provided, all venues will be considered by default.

function_schema.name: find_card_in_deck
function_schema.description: Locate a particular card in a deck based on rank and suit.

rank.description: Rank of the card (e.g. Ace, Two, King).

suit.description: Suit of the card (e.g. Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).

deck.description: Deck of cards. If not provided, the deck will be a default standard 52 card deck

function_schema.name: vegan_restaurant.find_nearby
function_schema.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format. Default is 24

model_result_raw:
hotel_booking(location="舊金山", room_type="豪華", duration=3, start_date="2023-07-01", preferences=["寵物友善", "健身房"]), 
vegan_restaurant.find_nearby(location="舊金山", operating_hours=22), 
sports_team.get_schedule(team_name="金州勇士隊", num_of_games=5, league="NBA"), 
find_card_in_deck(rank="皇后", suit="紅心")

question.content: 想像一下你正在計劃在家裡度過一個溫馨的夜晚。你想要用一副撲克牌玩一個紙牌遊戲，但是你不確定這副牌裡是否有“紅心的國王”。你能檢查一下它是否在裡面嗎？之後，你打算煮一道需要兩杯糖的食譜，但是你只有一個湯匙來量。相當於兩杯糖有多少湯匙？另外，你的錢包裡有100歐元，你想知道它相當於美元多少。你能換算一下嗎？最後，你在考慮在花園裡添加一些新的植物。你住在舊金山，對提供“一年生”和“樹木”類型植物的苗圃有興趣。你能找到一些當地的苗圃嗎？

function_schema.name: find_card_in_deck
function_schema.description: Locate a particular card in a deck based on rank and suit.

rank.description: Rank of the card (e.g. Ace, Two, King).

suit.description: Suit of the card (e.g. Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).

deck.description: Deck of cards. If not provided, the deck will be a default standard 52 card deck

function_schema.name: currency_exchange.convert
function_schema.description: Convert an amount from a base currency to a target currency based on the current exchange rate.

amount.description: The amount in base currency to convert

function_schema.name: local_nursery.find
function_schema.description: Locate local nurseries based on location and plant types availability.

location.description: The city or locality where the nursery needs to be located.

plant_types.description: Type of plants the nursery should provide.

function_schema.name: recipe.unit_conversion
function_schema.description: Convert a value from one kitchen unit to another for cooking purposes.

from_unit.description: The unit to convert from. Supports 'teaspoon', 'tablespoon', 'cup', etc.

to_unit.description: The unit to convert to. Supports 'teaspoon', 'tablespoon', 'cup', etc.

precision.description: The precision to round the output to, in case of a non-integer result. Optional, default is 0.

model_result_raw: find_card_in_deck(rank='King', suit='Hearts'), recipe.unit_conversion(value=2, from_unit='cup', to_unit='tablespoon', precision=0), currency_exchange.convert(base_currency='EUR', target_currency='USD', amount=100), local_nursery.find(location='舊金山', plant_types=['一年生', '樹木'])
